_key: A lane is matched to cost.csv rows by (runner, stage) plus `project` when the lane declares one. Without the project term, medic and alert-triage collide — both are claude/triage — and the join would judge every claude lane against the strictest ceiling any claude lane declares (medic's 80K), so a build lane legitimately at 400K would be reported as a breach. A guard that fires when nothing is wrong is the alarm-that-always-rings.
_measured_note: measured_before is the PRE-DIET figure and is mostly withdrawn (see each lane's measured_before_note). `measured` is the POST-CAPTURE-REPAIR observation taken 2026-08-25, in the unit named in _units. They are different windows and must never be read as one series. Every lane carries either `measured` or `_unmeasured` with a reason — silence is not permitted, because a lane with no number reads exactly like a lane whose number is fine.

_unbudgeted_stages._why: DECLARED DEBT, and as of 2026-08-27 the debt is PAID: prd, mockup, signals, synth, map, probe and takeover now have lanes of their own, so ceiling_for resolves every (runner, stage, project) triple the fleet has actually run. The block stays because the shape is the point — a stage that runs with no lane belongs here, listed with a count, rather than being quietly exempted. An empty `stages` map means the fleet currently has no unbudgeted stage, which is a claim the completeness check re-tests on every run. 2026-08-28 (phase 4): `revise` joins them as product-revise. It was never in this debt list either — it had run too rarely to appear in the observed snapshot both guards were keyed on, so nothing had a reason to name it. The test now also resolves every LITERAL stage argument at an agent-call.sh call site in bin/, which is the direction that catches a stage on the day it is written instead of on the day it first bills.
_unbudgeted_stages._source: resolved against tests/fixtures/live-lane-triples.txt and the hub's own state/cost/fleet-cost.csv
_unbudgeted_stages._note_product_family: The sharpest case, and the one this resolution came from: product-ideation's notes said it 'covers the ideate/prd/mockup/signals/synth stage family' while its `stage` field held ONE value and both resolvers match stage exactly — so four of the five stages it claimed were funded from the tier. The fix is four sibling lanes with the same numbers, not a looser resolver: a row that says one thing in prose and another in its key is the runner-pin fault one field over, and the key is what binds.
_unbudgeted_stages._note_coordination_stages: NOT IN THIS MANIFEST, ON PURPOSE. Phase 4 of docs/DB-COORDINATION-SPEC.md enrolls bin/merge-sweep.sh in the jobs ledger under lane merge/fleet/none. That is a COORDINATION lane, not an LLM lane: merge-sweep makes no model call at all, so it has no context to compose and no ceiling to declare, and a row here would be four invented fields wearing a budget's clothes. It resolves to the worker's $3 tier default, spends $0, and says so. This manifest budgets context; the jobs table records claims. A lane can honestly be in one and not the other.
_unbudgeted_stages._note_e2e_stage: NOT IN THIS MANIFEST, ON PURPOSE, for exactly the reason above. The e2e phase bin/run-build.sh opens before review (bin/e2e-smoke.sh + bin/e2e-smoke.mjs) drives a Vercel preview deployment with playwright and makes NO model call at all: it composes no context, so it has no ceiling to declare and a row here would be invented fields wearing a budget's clothes. It is a PHASE on the build's own claim rather than a lane of its own, so it takes no second claim, resolves to no budget_catalog row, and spends $0 in cost.csv. The call-site scan in tests/context-budget-manifest-test.sh agrees by construction — it matches literal agent-call.sh stage arguments, and this stage never invokes agent-call.sh. This manifest budgets context; the jobs table records claims.

_bound_scopes: Every bound carries a [scope:id] tag. scope is one of account / runner / harness / lane and says WHAT the bound is a property of. A bound whose scope is not `lane` is ONE fact declared in several places, so its truth value must read identically everywhere — enforced generically in tests/context-budget-manifest-test.sh. This replaces a flag-specific clause that cured one instance of the class: --max-budget-usd is account-scoped (4 lanes), grok --max-turns is runner-scoped (2 lanes), prompt_guard is harness-scoped (8 lanes, ONE implementation) — a single finding on prompt_guard would otherwise need eight hand edits and would drift on the first one someone missed. bounds_evidence is KEYED BY BOUND ID, because a lane can carry more than one convicted bound (alert-triage now carries two) and a single evidence block could only ever describe one of them.
